config.notes: Stage M1 proper step 1. Full cards and prompts stay vault-side; only public profiles (age band, occupation type, household, area type; sampled independently of phi, seed 3150) are emitted system-side. Concurrency raised 3->6 mid-run (run is cached+resumable; backoff client absorbs upstream 429s); reasoning stays ON per frozen regime — the effort knob was tested and barely changes qwen reasoning spend. The 34 cards rendered unbounded were discarded (~USD 0.05, logged) and all 400 re-rendered uniformly.
